using a hybrid CID-MS/MS, ETD-MS/MS and CID-MS3 fragmentation scheme
both ETD and CID (normalised collision energy of 25%) fragmentation was performed
Two independent biological replicates (nuclei isolated from different cultures) were performed.
Replicate 1 consists of 23 fraction "F18" - "F40" with the date prefix 23102018. Replciate 2 consists of 23 fractions "F18" - F40" with the date prefix 01052019.
